findings.description: Marina López was the daughter of Manuel López G. and Carmen Nelia Casado.

target_person.name: Manuel López G. and Carmen Nelia Casado

supporting_sources: República Dominicana, Registro Civil, 1744-2019 — civil marriage act n.º 64, San José de Ocoa, recording the bride as 'hija legítima de Manuel López G. y Carmen Nelia Casado' (ark:/61903/1:1:6RPF-Q4K7; register image ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS18-834Z-4). The bride's given name is written ambiguously and may read Manna or Marina.

República Dominicana, Registro Civil, 1744-2019 — civil death act n.º 255, San José de Ocoa, 7 Nov 1978, for Juan de Dios Pichardo Chalas, naming his mother as Fidelina Chalas and his spouse as Marina López, which ties the groom of the 1937 marriage act to the tree person (ark:/61903/1:1:66H3-5D6G)

República Dominicana, Registro Civil, 1744-2019 — death registration of Fernando Andres Lopez, b. 1919, registered 26 Jan 1965 at San José de Ocoa, Peravia, naming his parents as Manuel Lopez and Carmen Nelia Casado; an independent record in the same locality naming the same parent couple (ark:/61903/1:1:6KHD-YBR7)

findings.description: Marina López married Juan de Dios Pichardo Chalas on 7 October 1937 in San José de Ocoa, Peravia, Dominican Republic.

details.place: San José de Ocoa, Peravia, Dominican Republic

supporting_sources: República Dominicana, Registro Civil, 1744-2019 — civil marriage act n.º 64, San José de Ocoa, 'a los sete dias del mes de Octúbre del año mil novecientos treintaisiete' (ark:/61903/1:1:6RPF-Q4K7; register image ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS18-834Z-4). FamilySearch's index of this record gives the year as 1927; the register reads 1937.
